"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"We will close provider gaps and increase diversity in the health care profession by creating a robust pipeline of talent with career ladders for advancement.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"We will increase opportunities for community health workers to come from the communities they serve.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
